checks.name: CK_ACCOUNT_Owner
checks.definition: ([Role]='TEACHER' AND [TeacherId] IS NOT NULL AND [EmployeeId] IS NULL OR [Role]<>'TEACHER' AND [EmployeeId] IS NOT NULL AND [TeacherId] IS NULL)

checks.name: CK_PLACEMENT_TEST_Scores
checks.definition: ([ListeningScore]>=(0) AND [ListeningScore]<=(10) AND ([SpeakingScore]>=(0) AND [SpeakingScore]<=(10)) AND ([ReadingScore]>=(0) AND [ReadingScore]<=(10)) AND ([WritingScore]>=(0) AND [WritingScore]<=(10)))

checks.name: CK_STUDENT_Contact
checks.definition: ([Phone] IS NOT NULL OR [GuardianPhone] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: CK_STUDENT_Guardian
checks.definition: (dateadd(year,(18),[DateOfBirth])<=[RegisteredOn] OR [GuardianName] IS NOT NULL AND [GuardianPhone] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: CK_STUDENT_Status
checks.definition: ([Status]=N'Completed' OR [Status]=N'Dropped out' OR [Status]=N'On hold' OR [Status]=N'Studying' OR [Status]=N'Prospective')
